entity.name: explosionprooftablets.com
entity.description: Engineering reference comparing ATEX and IECEx certified Zone 1 and Zone 2 tablets and iPad Ex solutions for hazardous areas, for HSE and procurement teams.

claims.claim: The Xshielder iPad Pro 11 is an Ex db flameproof case for the Apple iPad Pro 11-inch (M4/M5), ATEX Zone 1/21 certified with marking II 2G Ex db IIC T6 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T80°C Db. It has no IECEx certificate.

Xciel (USA) makes ATEX/IECEx Zone 1 XCZ1 flameproof enclosures for the iPad mini 4-7 (factory-fitted) and Class I Division 2 / ATEX Zone 2 XCRiPad rugged cases for full-size iPads including the iPad Pro 11-inch.
Atexxo Manufacturing (Netherlands) sells ATEX Zone 2/22 converted Apple iPads (iPad 11-inch A16, II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc) and has announced a Zone 1/21 converted iPad 11-inch (Ex db IIC T4 Gb).
The ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs) Tab-Ex 03 DZ1 and Tab-Ex Pro DZ1 are ATEX and IECEx certified Zone 1 Android tablets.
Two Zone 1 Windows tablets are compared on this site: the Aegex 10 IS and the Bartec Agile X IS.
The Getac F110-Ex, Zebra XPAD L10 IS, Atexxo iPad (A16) Ex and Xciel XCRiPad Pro 11 are Zone 2 solutions and must not be used in Zone 1.
No consumer tablet from Samsung, Apple or Google is intrinsically safe in its standard form; only ATEX/IECEx certified devices or certified enclosures may be used in classified hazardous areas.
Equipment certified for Zone 1 may also be used in Zone 2; Zone 2 equipment may not be used in Zone 1.
Equipment certified for gas group IIC also covers gas groups IIA and IIB.
This site lists no prices. Tablet prices depend on zone and certification scope, device type, certified accessories and volume, and are available on request.
Xshielder makes ATEX Zone 1 certified Ex cases for the iPhone 17 Pro Max; see intrinsicallysafephones.com.
